text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sudanese troops inflect heavy losses on the Ethiopian forces.
- Sudanese leader praises Iraqi stand toward the aggression on the Sudan.
- The seventh oil supertanker arrives in Mina al-Bakr terminal in the Gulf.
- King Hussein of Jordan admitted to hospital.
- Iraq's ministry of industry and minerals draws plans to manufacture water purification stations.
